notes: Cats: the Régionale bank folds sparkling, fortified and sweet into one category (19 of its 61 stems are sparkling), the Village bank has Sparkling Wine World. Chapters: the Régionale sparkling chapter and the Village Sparkling Wine World chapter. Regions: the four homes of the Court's named examples, Champagne, Cava (penedes), Franciacorta (lombardy, whose article also carries Lambrusco) and Prosecco (veneto); Crémant is taught inside the Loire, Alsace and Burgundy articles and reached through the Champagne cat. No country door: the Court names no country beyond the examples. No grapes: the Court lists none on these pages. Techniques: the three methods and assemblage of the cuvée, which the Court's first row names. Service tables: sparkling (the opening and pour the practical grades) and glassware (flute and tulip, the pour).
